payload.description: A synthetic but internally consistent sales-demo corpus linking strategy, delivery, code, APIs, CI/CD, testing, design, knowledge, operations and evidence.

scenarios.story: The October 2 resilience qualification failed one timeout test. Inspect the 127 passed, one failed and two skipped results, the affected requirement and the later successful retry. This is synthetic historical evidence, not a failing EOIP demo operation.
scenarios.title: Explain a failed qualification without hiding the failure

scenarios.story: Distinguish the October 1 emergency configuration mitigation from the October 3 permanent code fix. Follow the replacement release to its passing pipeline, deployment and commit; compare both versions without overwriting history.
scenarios.title: Trace permanent remediation to a verified production release

scenarios.audience: Business owners, finance and portfolio leaders
scenarios.story: Trace a synthetic checkout conversion target to its capability, implemented feature, production API and release. KPI values are illustrative, not measured performance.
scenarios.title: Connect business value to production evidence

scenarios.story: Compare fail-open and safe-refusal alternatives, the superseded retry decision and the accepted bounded-risk outcome. Follow the decision to its implementation and remediation work.
scenarios.title: Explain a decision, alternatives and its revision

scenarios.story: Follow ordered response steps and inspect a delayed approval event. Expected and actual durations are synthetic seconds; the event records a deviation rather than claiming automated process mining.
scenarios.title: Compare designed incident response with an observed deviation

scenarios.story: Trace the checkout risk-control story through its merge request, commit, source file, API contract, test coverage and production deployment.
scenarios.title: Trace business intent to production

scenarios.story: Move from a payment latency incident to alerts, logs, dashboards, the triggering deployment and the approved remediation change.
scenarios.title: Correlate an incident to the deployment that triggered it

scenarios.story: Show the checkout service, its endpoints, downstream risk and payment services, monitors, documentation and contract tests.
scenarios.title: Assess API dependency blast radius

scenarios.story: Explain which commit, pipeline, jobs, artifact, approvals, tests and deployment comprise a release.
scenarios.title: Explain a governed release

scenarios.story: Connect automated test cases and their execution to the business story, implementation symbol and API endpoint they validate.
scenarios.title: Prove requirement and API test coverage

scenarios.story: Trace a Figma design file and reusable payment component to the feature and story that delivered it.
scenarios.title: Connect customer experience design to delivery

scenarios.story: Find the runbook, architecture decision and API documentation with the source evidence behind every connection.
scenarios.title: Find the trusted operational answer

scenarios.story: Use centrality, communities, similarity, anomaly detection, link prediction and what-if removal on a connected enterprise subgraph.
scenarios.title: Identify critical systems and hidden risk
